enunciado: Run a breadth-first search on the graph (adjacency matrix) from vertex 0 using an array queue. Show the visit order and the distance (in edges) of every reachable vertex; unreachable ones show -1.
objetivos: Get shortest distances in unweighted graphs
pistas: Mark a vertex as visited when ENQUEUING it, not when dequeuing it.
Initialize distances to -1: it means 'not reached'.
